items.html: And it is found that the essence of his body was above, in Yetzira, as is known that the body hints at the Vav of the Name HaVaYaH, and Yetzira too is hinted at by the letter Vav itself. And the feet of Adam HaRishon were placed in the six lower [Sefirot] of Assiya of that time, which are now the six first [Sefirot] of the present Yetzira. And behold, we have explained the expansion of Adam HaRishon in the three worlds — Beria, Yetzira, Assiya — at the time he was created.
